In this experiment you are to investigate the conditions affecting the rate of cooling of a beaker of
hot water.
Record all your observations and answers on pages 6 and 7 of the Answer Booklet.
You are provided with a supply of hot water. Carry out the following instructions referring to
Fig. 4.1.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Pour hot water into beaker Auntil it is about two-thirds full. Beaker Ais insulated. Do not
remove the insulation.

parts.text:

parts.text:

minutes.

parts.text:
Pour the water from beaker A into the measuring cylinder. Measure and record the volume V
of the water.

parts.label: e
parts.text:
Repeat steps (a)– (c)using beaker B. This beaker has a lid. As soon as you have poured
the hot water into the beaker, replace the lid as shown in Fig. 4.1 and do notremove the lid
during the experiment.

parts.text:
Look at the temperature readings obtained. State whether the insulation round beaker Aor
the lid on beaker B or neither of these is more effective in keeping the water hot. Justify your
answer by reference to the readings in your table.

three variables that could have affected the results of this experiment.
